summary: Phase 1.7 Timezone Hardening backend audit — ALL 6 areas PASS. Regression suite 27/27, adversarial smoke 7/7. POST /api/users, POST/PATCH /api/people/{uid}[/{pid}] all coordinate-driven; client-supplied fixed offsets are discarded when coords present and rejected when coords absent. Provenance fields (timezone_source='coordinates', timezone_resolver_version='1.0.0', timezone_resolved_at) persisted on every write path. Legacy KL stampers are env-gated (ENABLE_LEGACY_TIMEZONE_STAMPERS=false default) and did NOT execute on backend restart. timezone-integrity-summary counts IDENTICAL pre/post test (175 users, 26 IANA, 141 fixed offset, 8 missing). All test rows cleaned up via direct Mongo.

results_per_area.2_users_adversarial: PASS 4/4 (Buenos Aires +08:00→America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires; NY Asia/KL→America/New_York; KL UTC→Asia/Kuala_Lumpur; LA +00:00→America/Los_Angeles). All persisted with timezone_source=coordinates, timezone_resolver_version=1.0.0, timezone_resolved_at set.
results_per_area.3_saved_people_adversarial: PASS 3/3 (POST BA+offset→Buenos_Aires; PATCH to NY without tz→America/New_York; PATCH clear-loc+offset→HTTP 400 'Invalid timezone +08:00')
results_per_area.4_build_info: PASS — GET /api/admin/build-info returns 200 pre and post restart
results_per_area.5_legacy_stampers_off: PASS — Post-restart logs show NO 'Set ... timezone: Asia/Kuala_Lumpur' lines and NO stamper execution. All 4 legacy sites (server.py L27410, L32126, L32620, L32843) gated behind ENABLE_LEGACY_TIMEZONE_STAMPERS env flag (default false).
results_per_area.6_integrity_summary: PASS — IDENTICAL counts before/after (total=175, iana=26, fixed_offset=141, no_tz=8; top values 100% identical). Cleanup verified.

binary_anag_answer.question: Can a new AnaG-class defect still be created via POST /api/users, POST /api/people/{uid}, or PATCH /api/people/{uid}/{pid}?
proof: POST /api/users with Buenos Aires coords + timezone=+08:00 stored America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires (DB-verified), source=coordinates.
POST /api/users with NY coords + timezone=Asia/Kuala_Lumpur stored America/New_York (DB-verified).
POST /api/users with LA coords + timezone=+00:00 stored America/Los_Angeles (DB-verified).
POST /api/people/{uid} with BA coords + tz=+08:00 returned timezone=America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires.
PATCH /api/people/{uid}/{pid} moving birth_location to NY (no tz field) returned timezone=America/New_York (re-resolution on coord change confirmed).
PATCH with birth_location=null + tz=+08:00 correctly rejected with HTTP 400.

remaining_timezone_write_surfaces: None bypass the resolver. Audited all timezone writes in server.py: POST /api/users (hardened at ~L4135-4246), POST/PATCH /api/people/* (services/saved_people.py via _saved_person_resolve_tz), and 4 legacy stampers (L27410, L32126, L32620, L32843) all gated behind ENABLE_LEGACY_TIMEZONE_STAMPERS=false. The 3 geocoding search response sites (server.py L4015, L4077, L4118 inside /api/locations/search) return tz suggestions to clients using the resolver but never write to DB. No PATCH/PUT endpoint exists for /api/users/{id} that touches timezone (only /users/{id}/email writes email_updated_at).
db_cleanup_confirmed: Yes — adversarial test deleted 5 users + 1 saved_person row created during the run. Final timezone-integrity-summary counts match baseline exactly.
critical_code_review_comments: Coordinate-driven tz contract is enforced consistently across all write surfaces audited. Provenance fields are present on the response model for saved_people but NOT included in UserProfileResponse — consider exposing timezone_source/timezone_resolver_version on the user GET endpoint to make remediation progress observable from the frontend without direct Mongo reads.

_saved_person_resolve_tz raises HTTPException(400) if coords are present but resolver returns None (e.g. middle-of-ocean). Currently no test pins this branch — low risk but a future TC would harden it.
server.py is ~33k lines (well above the 700-line guideline). Out of scope here but worth flagging that the user-create + legacy migration paths would benefit from extraction into services/users.py.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1.7 timezone hardening is complete and verified. If revisiting: re-run `python3 -m pytest /app/backend/tests/test_timezone_resolution.py -v` and `python3 /app/backend/tests/adversarial_smoke.py`. The integrity baseline was 175 users (26 IANA / 141 fixed offset / 8 none) — historical users were intentionally NOT touched.
